subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures with `includeDetails` be hidden in cron, heartbeat, full-verbose, and mutating paths, or should those detail-warning contexts remain visible?
rationale: Current tests intentionally surface some exec details, while the PR and linked issue request suppressing exec-like warnings regardless of detail mode; that is a user-visible message policy choice rather than a mechanical one-line fix.

options.title: Preserve Detail Contexts
options.body: Keep cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec details visible and ask for a narrower fix that only suppresses the unwanted leak.

options.title: Suppress All Exec-Like Warnings
options.body: Approve hiding exec-like warning payloads before mutating handling, then update code, tests, and proof to match that behavior.

options.title: Pause This Branch
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged until the linked issue has a maintainer-approved warning-policy contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve Detail Contexts
recommendation.body: Keep cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec details visible and ask for a narrower fix that only suppresses the unwanted leak.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent history in the tool mutation and payload warning surfaces that determine the behavior under review.
